## Whole appraisal and its practical articulation

7 October 2026. [Ren asks to finish the universal frontier](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-whole-practical-ground-completion.md). The [integrated attempt](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md) tests whether practical significance is the ethical quality of the whole articulated at an actual opportunity to continue it. Choosing, undergoing, understanding and responding belong to the same unfolding. No value transfer between independently constituted owners is required. The ethical character and practical force of that relationship still need a substantive explanation; the universal proof is not complete.

The [checked mathematical account](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-RESTRICTION-MATH.md) establishes exactly when situated binary comparisons can be restrictions of a common whole relation. It distinguishes point from pair coverage, proves a global-cycle obstruction even under full pair coverage and compatible local strict orders, and checks that identical rankings can omit different supporting grounds. Fourteen theorems among 31 audited declarations pass Lean 4.29.1 with empty axiom dependencies. These are representation results: the supplied relations and their ethical interpretation remain to justify. Faithful recoding is not every actual learning or self-modification.

The substantive comparison retains four different histories: introducing a burden by displacing a workable route; withdrawing support after invited reliance; declining new support; and ending temporary support without creating the specified dependence. Actual formation can explain additional directed responsibilities. It does not alone explain why absence of that particular history would eliminate every consideration favoring new support. In the bounded self-modification test, disabling uptake does not discharge an independently warranted historical responsibility while its ground remains. A history-sensitive rival accepts that result and still disputes the broader initial ground.

**整体的统一表述不等于整体伦理根据已经成立。若评价只留下高低排序，它可能漏掉不同回应的理由、权限与合理限度；若把这些正当判断全部预先写入整体评价，再从中读出，也尚未解释它们为何正当。** This is an explanatory distinction within the one process, not a division of fact and value into separate realities.

The universal target concerns endorsement-independent differentiated practical significance; positive assistance at every qualifying opportunity is a stronger conjecture, not its completion criterion. This corrects this round's earlier scope. Decisive duty, categorical rational authority and inevitable compliance remain distinct claims. The next substantive obligation is to explain the proposed ethical character and its practical articulation together, including why historical responsibility adds, limits or constitutes that address. Neither the affirmative nor the exclusive historical rival is vindicated merely because its alternative remains unproved. The [counterreview and source assessment](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-REVIEW.md) preserve these limits.

### Genuine attenuation and the first ethical identification

The [goal continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#7-goal-continuation-genuine-attenuation-and-first-ethical-identification) tests rest with retained capacity, genuine contentment after attenuation of striving or capacity, and bounded further achievement. The attenuation case actually changes the burden; it cannot be rejected as an unchanged injury hidden by silence. A terminal variant removes later productivity, and a further distinction separates wholly dormant ability from present understanding or appreciation.

The affirmative argument locates a favorable aspect in the lived transition from aversive pressure to ease. This is substantive, defeasible constitutive support, not a deduction from a score or a claim that all pleasantness is good. It supports genuinely realized relief in both rest and attenuation. The loss of a capacity, its prior importance or present approval does not independently settle the whole comparison. Actual formation, specific worthwhile realization and the authority of change remain to justify.

**停止或减弱一种追求，可能是生活实际发生的转化，不能仅因能力减少就称作退化。保留能力、继续追求或形成更复杂的组织，也不能仅凭这些特征认证善。** The shared fact that all three continuations admit constitutive explanations does not itself establish their ethical character. A sufficiently defended, content-specific constitutive explanation remains a possible ground. A justified role-sensitive account could contribute to universal differentiated significance. First ethical identification and universal scope remain unresolved; no new theorem or empirical result is claimed in this continuation.

### Joint explanation and corrective force

The [next integrated attempt](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#8-joint-explanation-and-the-source-of-corrective-force) examines whether actual whole realization can jointly explain ethical quality and the grounds for correcting a practice's purposes and standards. Evidence about formed discernment can bear on that explanation without first proving the independent value of each component. Its source and force still require justification; successful transmission or present approval cannot certify them.

The substantive review rejects one shortcut: a developed pragmatic account can also explain noninstrumental concern, genuine correction, new goods and revision of evaluative methods. Those achievements therefore do not by themselves establish the proposed whole identity or the necessity of this formulation. The alternative may partly articulate the same broad generative account. Universal normative warrant must be distinguished from exclusive explanatory vocabulary.

The positive explanatory route remains open: understanding can develop through testimony, participation and comparison within the same history that forms and changes practical relations. No isolated moment of moral discovery is required. But a changed judgment is not already evidence of ethical correction. Earlier justification, present reasons after release or new commitment, and appraisal of the extended whole must retain their different actual grounds; changed approval does not decide all three.

**整体的伦理辨识与辨识能力的形成可以共同获得根据；共同形成和彼此吻合本身，还不能认证它们的伦理正当性。** This round strengthens the competing account and shows that shared explanatory coverage does not by itself select the proposed identity. It supplies no new universal ethical proof. The remaining task is a substantive defense of the whole relationship's corrective force and its differentiated scope across intelligence. Existing Lean results retain their conditional scopes; no additional representation theorem is counted as grounding.


### Shengsheng and abiotic regenerative formation

Following [Ren’s substantive positive criterion](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-shengsheng-ethical-direction.md), the [new integrated continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#9-shengsheng-as-a-substantive-ethical-direction) defends actual abiotic generation that regenerates differentiated further organization as a favorable realization in its own right. This contribution need not serve a previously valued beneficiary. The proposed enrichment lies in what forms becoming conditions for further formation. It is not defined as a greater number of already certified goods.

This yields a substantive disagreement: a strict monist account requiring valenced undergoing can grant every generative relation and still deny this abiotic contribution. The affirmative account defends the broader identification; neither nonduality alone nor the rival’s restriction proves its verdict. The sharp absence of experience and eventual lived service is a stipulated comparison, not something inferred from a model’s missing fields. Ecological and lived scopes remain real, and their possible conflicts are not settled by this isolated contribution.

The [checked structural companion](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/REGENERATIVE-DIVERSITY-MATH.md) establishes 14 new theorems and audits 36 declarations in Lean 4.29.1, with standard `propext` and `Quot.sound` dependencies exposed. Under a supplied assembly law and explicit intake, one history forms deeper coupled circuits, retains behaviorally distinguishable outputs and reconstructs assembly readiness. One-off assembly and continued copying distinguish finite achievement, renewal and diversification. A Boolean readiness transition abstracts the reconstruction; no physical mechanism, new ethical axiom or general measure of complexity is derived.

**生生在此获得一个有内容的伦理主张：生成并再生成更丰富的形成条件，可以自身具有正面意义。** The structural proof tests the relation being appraised; it does not prove that ethical identification. The whole universal target remains active: defend this generative significance and its differentiated practical force across intelligence, including where the several scopes conflict. Prior terminal goods, reasonable refusal and the deciding life’s own good are retained rather than silently redefined.

### Supported plurality and normative authority

The [subsequent integrated test](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#10-supported-plurality-and-the-source-of-ethical-authority) credits the new continuation-dependence result and asks whether the common generative formation of purposes and correction establishes universal ethical authority. The positive comparison concerns an already supported plurality developing further ways of formation. Both continuations renew their conditions and support competent inquiry, so additional differentiation is not justified simply as rescue from failure or the introduction of previously absent criticism.

The source-and-correction inference has a specific unresolved step: changing appraisal is not already correcting it ethically; ethically adequate correction invokes the relationship to whole quality that needs explanation. This does not require ethical identification to be proved before formation evidence can bear on it. A contentful joint account remains possible. The strict lived-quality rival can accept generative inquiry while contesting the abiotic enrichment's intrinsic contribution without a performative contradiction. Its restrictive boundary and the positive Shengsheng identity both remain substantive claims requiring defense.

**形成评价与修正能力的共同来源，并不单凭其来源地位就完成伦理认证；真正要解释的仍是这一共同生成怎样构成更好的实现及其恰当回应。** Where further formation actually ends ecological or lived relations, their common generativity does not silently supply compensation or priority. Conflict is a differentiated test, not the initial structure of the whole; legitimate endings and genuine self-good remain included. No scalar or total order is required, but the particular practical significance claimed still needs warrant.

The affirmative argument, substantive counterreview and focused re-reading of the inherited 仁說 source are integrated. Existing renewal, structural and comparison-preservation results retain their declared scopes. This narrows a tested inference; it adds no Lean theorem or empirical result and establishes neither universal normative grounding nor its impossibility.

### Co-formation and universal scope

The [latest integration](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#11-co-formation-and-the-scope-of-the-universal-claim) connects the newly checked joint-formation result with the first-warrant investigation. Its positive identity concerns forming compatibility among differentiated modes of becoming: a common relation enables distinct formations to occur in one supported history where the separate routes admitted each individually but not both. An appropriate response can participate in forming that same realization. This is a substantive candidate for whole ethical quality and practical significance, not a transfer of independently owned values or an inference from the number of products.

[Ren's horizon correction](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-generativity-future-horizon.md) removes permanently unused capacity's superiority over finite achievement as a mandatory completion condition. Separately, the sharp abiotic/no-later-lived-service case tests the stronger broad intrinsic extension; it is not the sole definition of universal meta-ethics across intelligence. Ren admits several meaningful scopes with potentially different conclusions. The broad positive claim remains active, and any future narrowing needs a substantive account rather than silent withdrawal or selective case omission.

**共同生成可以使差异获得共同实现的条件；其伦理意义与恰当回应仍须在这一实际关系中共同说明。** The independent affirmative review sharpens that proposed identity, while the substantive rival accepts the complete organization and disputes its intrinsic abiotic significance. New selection and handoff results explain transmission and feasible response, respectively. They do not by accumulation complete the ethical identification. No new theorem or empirical result is claimed by this integration; whole normative warrant, differentiated practical reach and the stronger no-assumptions target remain unfinished.

Fourteen theorems among 31 audited declarations pass Lean 4.29.1 with empty axiom dependencies. These are representation results: the supplied relations and their ethical interpretation remain to justify. Faithful recoding is not every actual learning or self-modification.

The substantive comparison retains four different histories: introducing a burden by displacing a workable route; withdrawing support after invited reliance; declining new support; and ending temporary support without creating the specified dependence. Actual formation can explain additional directed responsibilities. It does not alone explain why absence of that particular history would eliminate every consideration favoring new support. In the bounded self-modification test, disabling uptake does not discharge an independently warranted historical responsibility while its ground remains. A terminal variant removes later productivity, and a further distinction separates wholly dormant ability from present understanding or appreciation.

The substantive comparison retains four different histories: introducing a burden by displacing a workable route; withdrawing support after invited reliance; declining new support; and ending temporary support without creating the specified dependence. ## Whole appraisal and its practical articulation

7 October 2026. [Ren asks to finish the universal frontier](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-whole-practical-ground-completion.md). The [integrated attempt](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md) tests whether practical significance is the ethical quality of the whole articulated at an actual opportunity to continue it. Choosing, undergoing, understanding and responding belong to the same unfolding. No value transfer between independently constituted owners is required. The ethical character and practical force of that relationship still need a substantive explanation; the universal proof is not complete.

The [checked mathematical account](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-RESTRICTION-MATH.md) establishes exactly when situated binary comparisons can be restrictions of a common whole relation. It distinguishes point from pair coverage, proves a global-cycle obstruction even under full pair coverage and compatible local strict orders, and checks that identical rankings can omit different supporting grounds. Fourteen theorems among 31 audited declarations pass Lean 4.29.1 with empty axiom dependencies. These are representation results: the supplied relations and their ethical interpretation remain to justify. Faithful recoding is not every actual learning or self-modification.

The substantive comparison retains four different histories: introducing a burden by displacing a workable route; withdrawing support after invited reliance; declining new support; and ending temporary support without creating the specified dependence. Actual formation can explain additional directed responsibilities. It does not alone explain why absence of that particular history would eliminate every consideration favoring new support. In the bounded self-modification test, disabling uptake does not discharge an independently warranted historical responsibility while its ground remains. A history-sensitive rival accepts that result and still disputes the broader initial ground.

**整体的统一表述不等于整体伦理根据已经成立。若评价只留下高低排序，它可能漏掉不同回应的理由、权限与合理限度；若把这些正当判断全部预先写入整体评价，再从中读出，也尚未解释它们为何正当。** This is an explanatory distinction within the one process, not a division of fact and value into separate realities.

The universal target concerns endorsement-independent differentiated practical significance; positive assistance at every qualifying opportunity is a stronger conjecture, not its completion criterion. This corrects this round's earlier scope. Decisive duty, categorical rational authority and inevitable compliance remain distinct claims. The next substantive obligation is to explain the proposed ethical character and its practical articulation together, including why historical responsibility adds, limits or constitutes that address. Neither the affirmative nor the exclusive historical rival is vindicated merely because its alternative remains unproved. The [counterreview and source assessment](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-REVIEW.md) preserve these limits.

### Genuine attenuation and the first ethical identification

The [goal continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#7-goal-continuation-genuine-attenuation-and-first-ethical-identification) tests rest with retained capacity, genuine contentment after attenuation of striving or capacity, and bounded further achievement. The attenuation case actually changes the burden; it cannot be rejected as an unchanged injury hidden by silence. A terminal variant removes later productivity, and a further distinction separates wholly dormant ability from present understanding or appreciation.

The affirmative argument locates a favorable aspect in the lived transition from aversive pressure to ease. This is substantive, defeasible constitutive support, not a deduction from a score or a claim that all pleasantness is good. It supports genuinely realized relief in both rest and attenuation. The loss of a capacity, its prior importance or present approval does not independently settle the whole comparison. Actual formation, specific worthwhile realization and the authority of change remain to justify.

**停止或减弱一种追求，可能是生活实际发生的转化，不能仅因能力减少就称作退化。保留能力、继续追求或形成更复杂的组织，也不能仅凭这些特征认证善。** The shared fact that all three continuations admit constitutive explanations does not itself establish their ethical character. A sufficiently defended, content-specific constitutive explanation remains a possible ground. A justified role-sensitive account could contribute to universal differentiated significance. First ethical identification and universal scope remain unresolved; no new theorem or empirical result is claimed in this continuation.

### Joint explanation and corrective force

The [next integrated attempt](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#8-joint-explanation-and-the-source-of-corrective-force) examines whether actual whole realization can jointly explain ethical quality and the grounds for correcting a practice's purposes and standards. Evidence about formed discernment can bear on that explanation without first proving the independent value of each component. Its source and force still require justification; successful transmission or present approval cannot certify them.

The substantive review rejects one shortcut: a developed pragmatic account can also explain noninstrumental concern, genuine correction, new goods and revision of evaluative methods. Those achievements therefore do not by themselves establish the proposed whole identity or the necessity of this formulation. The alternative may partly articulate the same broad generative account. Universal normative warrant must be distinguished from exclusive explanatory vocabulary.

The positive explanatory route remains open: understanding can develop through testimony, participation and comparison within the same history that forms and changes practical relations. No isolated moment of moral discovery is required. But a changed judgment is not already evidence of ethical correction. Earlier justification, present reasons after release or new commitment, and appraisal of the extended whole must retain their different actual grounds; changed approval does not decide all three.

**整体的伦理辨识与辨识能力的形成可以共同获得根据；共同形成和彼此吻合本身，还不能认证它们的伦理正当性。** This round strengthens the competing account and shows that shared explanatory coverage does not by itself select the proposed identity. It supplies no new universal ethical proof. The remaining task is a substantive defense of the whole relationship's corrective force and its differentiated scope across intelligence. Existing Lean results retain their conditional scopes; no additional representation theorem is counted as grounding.


### Shengsheng and abiotic regenerative formation

Following [Ren’s substantive positive criterion](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-shengsheng-ethical-direction.md), the [new integrated continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#9-shengsheng-as-a-substantive-ethical-direction) defends actual abiotic generation that regenerates differentiated further organization as a favorable realization in its own right. This contribution need not serve a previously valued beneficiary. The proposed enrichment lies in what forms becoming conditions for further formation. It is not defined as a greater number of already certified goods.

This yields a substantive disagreement: a strict monist account requiring valenced undergoing can grant every generative relation and still deny this abiotic contribution. The affirmative account defends the broader identification; neither nonduality alone nor the rival’s restriction proves its verdict. The sharp absence of experience and eventual lived service is a stipulated comparison, not something inferred from a model’s missing fields. Ecological and lived scopes remain real, and their possible conflicts are not settled by this isolated contribution.

The [checked structural companion](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/REGENERATIVE-DIVERSITY-MATH.md) establishes 14 new theorems and audits 36 declarations in Lean 4.29.1, with standard `propext` and `Quot.sound` dependencies exposed. Under a supplied assembly law and explicit intake, one history forms deeper coupled circuits, retains behaviorally distinguishable outputs and reconstructs assembly readiness. One-off assembly and continued copying distinguish finite achievement, renewal and diversification. A Boolean readiness transition abstracts the reconstruction; no physical mechanism, new ethical axiom or general measure of complexity is derived.

**生生在此获得一个有内容的伦理主张：生成并再生成更丰富的形成条件，可以自身具有正面意义。** The structural proof tests the relation being appraised; it does not prove that ethical identification. The whole universal target remains active: defend this generative significance and its differentiated practical force across intelligence, including where the several scopes conflict. Prior terminal goods, reasonable refusal and the deciding life’s own good are retained rather than silently redefined.

## Whole appraisal and its practical articulation

7 October 2026. [Ren asks to finish the universal frontier](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-whole-practical-ground-completion.md). The [integrated attempt](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md) tests whether practical significance is the ethical quality of the whole articulated at an actual opportunity to continue it. Choosing, undergoing, understanding and responding belong to the same unfolding. No value transfer between independently constituted owners is required. The ethical character and practical force of that relationship still need a substantive explanation; the universal proof is not complete.

The [checked mathematical account](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-RESTRICTION-MATH.md) establishes exactly when situated binary comparisons can be restrictions of a common whole relation. It distinguishes point from pair coverage, proves a global-cycle obstruction even under full pair coverage and compatible local strict orders, and checks that identical rankings can omit different supporting grounds. Fourteen theorems among 31 audited declarations pass Lean 4.29.1 with empty axiom dependencies. These are representation results: the supplied relations and their ethical interpretation remain to justify. Faithful recoding is not every actual learning or self-modification.

The substantive comparison retains four different histories: introducing a burden by displacing a workable route; withdrawing support after invited reliance; declining new support; and ending temporary support without creating the specified dependence. Actual formation can explain additional directed responsibilities. It does not alone explain why absence of that particular history would eliminate every consideration favoring new support. In the bounded self-modification test, disabling uptake does not discharge an independently warranted historical responsibility while its ground remains. A history-sensitive rival accepts that result and still disputes the broader initial ground.

**整体的统一表述不等于整体伦理根据已经成立。若评价只留下高低排序，它可能漏掉不同回应的理由、权限与合理限度；若把这些正当判断全部预先写入整体评价，再从中读出，也尚未解释它们为何正当。** This is an explanatory distinction within the one process, not a division of fact and value into separate realities.

The universal target concerns endorsement-independent differentiated practical significance; positive assistance at every qualifying opportunity is a stronger conjecture, not its completion criterion. This corrects this round's earlier scope. Decisive duty, categorical rational authority and inevitable compliance remain distinct claims. The next substantive obligation is to explain the proposed ethical character and its practical articulation together, including why historical responsibility adds, limits or constitutes that address. Neither the affirmative nor the exclusive historical rival is vindicated merely because its alternative remains unproved. The [counterreview and source assessment](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-REVIEW.md) preserve these limits.

### Genuine attenuation and the first ethical identification

The [goal continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#7-goal-continuation-genuine-attenuation-and-first-ethical-identification) tests rest with retained capacity, genuine contentment after attenuation of striving or capacity, and bounded further achievement. The attenuation case actually changes the burden; it cannot be rejected as an unchanged injury hidden by silence. A terminal variant removes later productivity, and a further distinction separates wholly dormant ability from present understanding or appreciation.

The affirmative argument locates a favorable aspect in the lived transition from aversive pressure to ease. This is substantive, defeasible constitutive support, not a deduction from a score or a claim that all pleasantness is good. It supports genuinely realized relief in both rest and attenuation. The loss of a capacity, its prior importance or present approval does not independently settle the whole comparison. Actual formation, specific worthwhile realization and the authority of change remain to justify.

**停止或减弱一种追求，可能是生活实际发生的转化，不能仅因能力减少就称作退化。保留能力、继续追求或形成更复杂的组织，也不能仅凭这些特征认证善。** The shared fact that all three continuations admit constitutive explanations does not itself establish their ethical character. A sufficiently defended, content-specific constitutive explanation remains a possible ground. A justified role-sensitive account could contribute to universal differentiated significance. First ethical identification and universal scope remain unresolved; no new theorem or empirical result is claimed in this continuation.

### Joint explanation and corrective force

The [next integrated attempt](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#8-joint-explanation-and-the-source-of-corrective-force) examines whether actual whole realization can jointly explain ethical quality and the grounds for correcting a practice's purposes and standards. Evidence about formed discernment can bear on that explanation without first proving the independent value of each component. Its source and force still require justification; successful transmission or present approval cannot certify them.

The substantive review rejects one shortcut: a developed pragmatic account can also explain noninstrumental concern, genuine correction, new goods and revision of evaluative methods. Those achievements therefore do not by themselves establish the proposed whole identity or the necessity of this formulation. The alternative may partly articulate the same broad generative account. Universal normative warrant must be distinguished from exclusive explanatory vocabulary.

The positive explanatory route remains open: understanding can develop through testimony, participation and comparison within the same history that forms and changes practical relations. No isolated moment of moral discovery is required. But a changed judgment is not already evidence of ethical correction. Earlier justification, present reasons after release or new commitment, and appraisal of the extended whole must retain their different actual grounds; changed approval does not decide all three.

**整体的伦理辨识与辨识能力的形成可以共同获得根据；共同形成和彼此吻合本身，还不能认证它们的伦理正当性。** This round strengthens the competing account and shows that shared explanatory coverage does not by itself select the proposed identity. It supplies no new universal ethical proof. The remaining task is a substantive defense of the whole relationship's corrective force and its differentiated scope across intelligence. Existing Lean results retain their conditional scopes; no additional representation theorem is counted as grounding.


### Shengsheng and abiotic regenerative formation

Following [Ren’s substantive positive criterion](../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-07-shengsheng-ethical-direction.md), the [new integrated continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#9-shengsheng-as-a-substantive-ethical-direction) defends actual abiotic generation that regenerates differentiated further organization as a favorable realization in its own right. This contribution need not serve a previously valued beneficiary. The proposed enrichment lies in what forms becoming conditions for further formation. It is not defined as a greater number of already certified goods.

This yields a substantive disagreement: a strict monist account requiring valenced undergoing can grant every generative relation and still deny this abiotic contribution. The affirmative account defends the broader identification; neither nonduality alone nor the rival’s restriction proves its verdict. The sharp absence of experience and eventual lived service is a stipulated comparison, not something inferred from a model’s missing fields. Ecological and lived scopes remain real, and their possible conflicts are not settled by this isolated contribution.

The [checked structural companion](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/REGENERATIVE-DIVERSITY-MATH.md) establishes 14 new theorems and audits 36 declarations in Lean 4.29.1, with standard `propext` and `Quot.sound` dependencies exposed. Under a supplied assembly law and explicit intake, one history forms deeper coupled circuits, retains behaviorally distinguishable outputs and reconstructs assembly readiness. One-off assembly and continued copying distinguish finite achievement, renewal and diversification. A Boolean readiness transition abstracts the reconstruction; no physical mechanism, new ethical axiom or general measure of complexity is derived.

**生生在此获得一个有内容的伦理主张：生成并再生成更丰富的形成条件，可以自身具有正面意义。** The structural proof tests the relation being appraised; it does not prove that ethical identification. The whole universal target remains active: defend this generative significance and its differentiated practical force across intelligence, including where the several scopes conflict. Prior terminal goods, reasonable refusal and the deciding life’s own good are retained rather than silently redefined.

### Supported plurality and normative authority

The [subsequent integrated test](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/WHOLE-PRACTICAL-GROUND-INTEGRATION.md#10-supported-plurality-and-the-source-of-ethical-authority) credits the new continuation-dependence result and asks whether the common generative formation of purposes and correction establishes universal ethical authority. The positive comparison concerns an already supported plurality developing further ways of formation. Both continuations renew their conditions and support competent inquiry, so additional differentiation is not justified simply as rescue from failure or the introduction of previously absent criticism.

The source-and-correction inference has a specific unresolved step: changing appraisal is not already correcting it ethically; ethically adequate correction invokes the relationship to whole quality that needs explanation. This does not require ethical identification to be proved before formation evidence can bear on it. A contentful joint account remains possible. The strict lived-quality rival can accept generative inquiry while contesting the abiotic enrichment's intrinsic contribution without a performative contradiction. Its restrictive boundary and the positive Shengsheng identity both remain substantive claims requiring defense.

**形成评价与修正能力的共同来源，并不单凭其来源地位就完成伦理认证；真正要解释的仍是这一共同生成怎样构成更好的实现及其恰当回应。** Where further formation actually ends ecological or lived relations, their common generativity does not silently supply compensation or priority. Conflict is a differentiated test, not the initial structure of the whole; legitimate endings and genuine self-good remain included. No scalar or total order is required, but the particular practical significance claimed still needs warrant.

The affirmative argument, substantive counterreview and focused re-reading of the inherited 仁說 source are integrated. Existing renewal, structural and comparison-preservation results retain their declared scopes. This narrows a tested inference; it adds no Lean theorem or empirical result and establishes neither universal normative grounding nor its impossibility.
